description: A Perl script for flashing firmware onto a Linksys ADSL2MUE device. It includes functionalities for device discovery over UDP, FTP connection management, reading firmware files, and uploading firmware to specific device partitions.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods tailored for the ADAM2 FTP commands, including environment variable retrieval and reboot command.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
